reviews.comment: An AutoCad assignment can be due that night of, and he will still host a Zoom call for students who truly need help. Autocad part of the class is probably the most time consuming, but he is there to always help.

Professor Clarke is awesome! This class is definitely one of my favorites. He truly cares about his students and makes sure everyone is learning. He promptly answers emails and will help you at any time of day to make sure you understand the material. This class has a lot of assignments, but they help you learn. No exams, weekly online quizzes.

You HAVE to show up to lab, but it's really not a difficult class. Just a lot of work. If you need help, Prof. Clarke is super helpful if you go see him in his office. He's very passionate about surveying and a nice guy all-around.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Clarke is such an amazing professor as well as just a great human. He is so passionate about surveying and ensuring that you understand the material and even enjoy it. The class is not a blow off, but it is also not difficult. Put the work in and take the time to get to know him. I have so much respect for Professors like Clarke!!

Class is v easy, especially with a good group (your group is randomly assigned). Just show up to lab and complete your weekly field books. Ther are weekly online quizzes that are easy (you get 2 attempts), & occasional attendance quizzes. AutoCAD is needed, but he posts step-by-step tutorials so its not bad. I would say this is a very easy A class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes
